show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/Suf5cw
show.description: “Share Bazaar Ka Secret Billionaire” follows Daksh, a humble billionaire with a golden heart, whose wife Samaira, a ruthless tech entrepreneur, is manipulated by deceitful allies into believing he’s unfaithful. As betrayals, corporate conspiracies, and tragic misunderstandings unfold, Daksh’s true identity as Mr. Ocean, a secret magnate, is revealed. In a storm of revenge and redemption, love, greed, and ambition collide — ending with truth triumphing over deceit and Daksh reclaiming his honour.
